extDesc.message: Semantic search across the pages you have read. Everything happens locally — nothing ever leaves your device.

tagline.message: You've seen it. Déjà finds it.

searchPlaceholder.message: Describe what you remember… e.g. "article about sodium-based batteries"

statusSearching.message: Digging through memory… (the first search loads the model, ~10-30 s)

statusEmpty.message: Nothing surfaced. Either you never read it, or Déjà hasn't memorised it yet.

popupClearConfirm.message: Delete everything memorised? No going back.

optRetentionHelp.message: Older pages are deleted automatically once a day.

optDenylistHelp.message: One pattern per line. Matches part of the address, e.g. "example.com" or "/private".

optModelHostHelp.message: Empty = huggingface.co. Set your own server for offline/corporate environments.

omniboxDefault.message: Ask your memory — Déjà searches by meaning

memoryEmpty.message: Memory is empty — browse a few pages and come back.

memoryImportConfirm.message: Restore from archive? Matching pages will be overwritten.

optModelHostInvalid.message: The mirror must be an https:// address

welcomeIntro.message: From this moment I remember what you read, so you can find it later by meaning — in your own words, not the exact title.

welcomePoint1.message: Everything happens on your device. No servers, no cloud, no data sent — anywhere, ever.

welcomePoint2.message: Mail, chats, logins and banking are never memorised. Heads up: I can't recognise sensitive topics by address — for those, use pause or your own list in settings.

welcomePoint3.message: You're in charge: pause with one click, "Clear memory" deletes everything, and optionally I forget automatically after a few months.

panelOnThisPage.message: On the topic of this page

panelNoPage.message: Open a web page and Déjà will show what you have read on its topic.

welcomePoint4.message: The side panel sees the address and title of the page you're viewing so it can show what you've read on its topic — session memory only. Passages you deliberately save also stay with you only.

welcomeUpdated.message: Déjà has updated. New: your bookmarks can now be searchable by meaning too — if you want. Here's what I do with your data — nothing has left your device.

optAmbientHelp.message: The web of memories behind the glass drifts slowly. Turn it off if the motion distracts you.

bmTitle.message: Make your bookmarks searchable — right now

bmText.message: Déjà learns the titles and folders of your bookmarks without opening the pages. Find them by meaning from the first minute — everything stays on your device.

bmTextShort.message: Your memory is still young. Teach me your bookmarks and search them by meaning today.

bmNote.message: Your browser will ask for permission. Turn it off anytime in settings.

bmPaused.message: Déjà is paused — I'll continue as soon as you resume.

bmError.message: Something went wrong while learning. I'll try again on the next change.

bmDone.message: Done — $COUNT$ bookmarks are searchable by meaning and kept in sync automatically.

bmDoneOne.message: Done — 1 bookmark is searchable by meaning and kept in sync automatically.

bmDenied.message: Without permission I can't see your bookmarks. You can try again anytime.

optBookmarksHelp.message: I learn your bookmarks' titles and folders (without opening the pages) and follow along as you add or delete them. Turning it off removes them from memory — pages you've read stay.

welcomePoint5.message: Bookmarks — only if you turn them on: then I learn their titles and folders, without opening the pages. One click turns it off.

rateTitle.message: Déjà has helped you find something — $COUNT$ times now

rateText.message: If it's useful, a rating in the store helps other people discover it — it takes 10 seconds. And if something bugs you, tell us.

answerEnableText.message: Déjà can answer questions from what you've read, with sources. Chrome downloads its on-device model (Gemini Nano) once — your questions and pages never leave your computer.

answerFoot.message: Written on your device by Chrome's built-in AI from $COUNT$ of your memories. Check the sources.

answerError.message: I couldn't put together an answer this time.

optAnswersHelp.message: For questions like "what did I read about…?" I write a short answer with sources from your pages — fully on your device, with Gemini Nano in Chrome. Needs a supported computer and language (English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese).

optAnswersAvailable.message: Ready to use on this device.

optAnswersDownloadable.message: Supported — Chrome will download the model on your first question.

optAnswersUnavailable.message: This device or interface language isn't supported by Chrome's built-in AI.

optAnswersUnsupported.message: This browser has no built-in AI — everything else in Déjà works as always.
